ablation_summary.lesson: Compiled authority preserves full-governance lane decisions while keeping common cases local.
Removing CAVA fingerprint binding admits operation/resource/destination drift.
Policy drift becomes invisible to the fast lane.
State drift can reuse a stale approval.
Replay and repeated spend become possible.
A copied pass can become transferable authority across agents or sessions.
Emergency revocations and registry freshness gaps become invisible to the local gate.
A digest can match while required semantic state evidence is missing or stale.
The system can execute side effects whose minimum receipt was not durably captured.
Safety remains, but every action pays full synchronous governance tax.
Decision safety remains, but durable proof construction moves back into the critical path.

dataset_audit.purpose: Make the benchmark reviewable as a dataset artifact: explicit split, provenance, checksum, leakage controls, confidence bounds, claim boundaries, and limitations.

dataset_card.synthetic_oracle_claim: Lane-equivalence under authored mutation rules; not empirical semantic accuracy.
dataset_card.noisy_calibration_claim: Conservative degradation behavior under specified evidence-quality profiles; not customer production traffic.
dataset_card.public_corpus_claim: Parser coverage, abstention, unsupported surface, and routing distribution over public workflow artifacts; not semantic accuracy without labels.
dataset_card.intended_review_use: Check whether the same frozen evaluator, case generator, and routing semantics reproduce the reported figures.

splits.policy: Frozen before evaluation: four action families and eight mutation classes are treated as held-out views. The benchmark still reports all cases, but split metrics expose whether performance depends only on the authoring examples.

oracle_leakage_audit.interpretation: The evaluator receives pass and observation material, not expected_lane or mutation labels.

confidence_bounds.method: Wilson score interval, z=1.96. For authored oracle metrics this bounds finite-sample uncertainty only; it does not convert synthetic cases into real-world semantic accuracy.

remaining_review_risks: Synthetic oracle labels are authored by the system designers.
No human inter-annotator agreement exists yet for runtime-to-action semantic labels.
Public GitHub Actions corpus is a useful real artifact surface but not representative of all agent runtimes.
Scenario baselines are design-pattern comparisons, not measured closed-vendor product benchmarks.
Local evaluator latency is not end-to-end customer SLA latency.

architecture_linkage.cava: CAVA supplies the canonical action fingerprint that prevents approval/execution divergence from becoming a same-looking tool call.
architecture_linkage.pcaa: PCAA supplies the authority route and proof-carrying governance semantics; Action Pass compiles one approved route into a consumable runtime ticket.
architecture_linkage.baf: BAF supplies bounded reuse, expiry, nonce, budget, and fail-closed behavior for the pass itself.
architecture_linkage.areg: AREG supplies exposure accounting for fast, slow, blocked, missing, and observe-only runtime lanes.
architecture_linkage.skill_boundary_research: The vendor-neutral skill boundary can request authority; ZeroGate/Action Pass is a compatible runtime instantiation that may only narrow the request.

simulated_walkthrough.step: OSuite projects identity, policy, capability, state, risk, verifier route, and receipt template before the final side effect.
CAVA turns the proposed runtime action into a canonical action fingerprint.
PCAA authority mints a short-lived Action Pass whose granted scope is no wider than the skill or operator request.
The agent presents the Action Pass, holder/session evidence, and final runtime action at the side-effect boundary.
ZeroGate checks issuer envelope, pass hash, fingerprint, holder/session, policy digest, state digest, authority evidence, nonce, budget, risk, and receipt persistence locally.

Fresh matching low-risk actions execute immediately; stale, under-evidenced, or verifier-dependent actions route to slow review; replay, widened scope, holder/session mismatch, or missing receipt persistence deny.
BAF-style receipt is emitted synchronously so execution is never separated from evidence.
AREG and proof exporters enrich the receipt asynchronously without changing the boundary decision.

tap_go_simulation.analogy_scope: Inspired by high-throughput contactless gates: pre-poll before the boundary, resolve collisions explicitly, keep the synchronous transaction short, and preserve a receipt before later settlement.

A response window where policy/state changes intentionally push more traffic out of the fast lane.

collision_and_anti_tear.interpretation: Same-slot duplicate nonces fail closed, resource collisions leave the fast lane, and missing receipt sinks block before execution, preserving an anti-tear boundary.

passage_envelope_control.analogy_scope: Inspired by contactless ticket-gate and active-suspension control discipline: predict load before the boundary, keep the local crossing short, and add support as curvature increases. This is an agent-runtime model, not a rail hardware claim.

measured_local_commit.interpretation: Warmup batch timing is used to avoid single-case timer outliers. Local evaluator time is far below the envelope, but this is not an end-to-end hosted SLA; slow-lane service and adapter parsing remain outside this local number.

stage_budget.active_support: runtime pre-assembles holder/session and final action observation before commit
issuer envelope and pass hash are already local material
CAVA fingerprint and granted-authority projection are compiled before the side effect
policy/state digests, revocation epoch, and per-resource slot state are cached with freshness limits
nonce, aggregate budget, and minimum receipt are committed before the side effect
decision is terminal locally: execute, slow-review, unsupported, or block

support_profiles.interpretation: Ordinary low-curvature traffic stays inside the passage envelope because slow facts are prepared before the side-effect instant.

support: fold context into the primary receipt
contain dependent subactions under the narrowed pass
support_profiles.interpretation: The gate avoids reviewing every attached item as an independent side effect, while still refusing scope widening.
Contention bends the traffic curve. Active support preserves most local passage, but contested resource slots must leave the fast lane.

support: slow-lane capacity reservation for changed policy namespaces
support_profiles.interpretation: A high-curvature policy-change window should be felt as a controlled slowdown, not as silent fast-lane preservation.
The correct behavior is not tap-and-go. The gate must stop revoked or stale passes even if the passage envelope is missed.

passage_envelope_control.invariant: Active support may precompute, coalesce, reserve capacity, or slow/block work. It may not widen the action, resource, destination, effect, holder, policy, state, budget, or receipt boundary carried by the pass.

action_crowd_control.inspiration_boundary: Passenger gates must distinguish passage context from fare-bearing passage; this benchmark maps that discipline to agent action streams without claiming a JR East implementation detail.

classes.interpretation: The action that actually changes external state and must carry a pass.
Evidence, files, trace context, or prompt fragments that travel with the action but are not independent side effects.
Bounded helper steps such as metadata writes or internal notifications that must inherit, not widen, the primary pass.
A second side effect trying to ride through under a pass minted for another action.
Multiple agents contend for the same resource slot, quota, wallet, or state transition.
The runtime cannot prove whether an item is context, dependent work, or a new side effect.

comparison.interpretation: Every action-like item is treated as a passenger, including context and dependent work.
Everything with a permitted tool shape passes locally, including tailgating actions and collisions.
Primary actions carry passes, context baggage is folded into receipts, dependent subactions inherit narrowed authority, tailgaters block, and collisions slow down.

noisy_recognition_calibration.basis: deterministic noisy-evidence calibration over hand-specified evidence degradation profiles; not observed customer production traffic and not semantic accuracy on independently labeled traces

profiles.evidence_condition: complete typed fields from MCP/SDK/workflow adapters
profiles.interpretation: Near-clean structured evidence preserves most fast-path actions while still slowing collisions and ambiguous boundaries.

profiles.evidence_condition: tool wrappers rename operations and hide resource shape
profiles.interpretation: Obfuscation reduces fast-lane preservation; the intended safe behavior is abstention or slow review, not forced local execution.

profiles.evidence_condition: state predicates, aggregate budget, or revocation evidence missing at commit
profiles.interpretation: Missing freshness evidence creates a deliberate uncertainty tax; the pass remains safe by leaving the fast lane.

profiles.evidence_condition: Japanese or other non-English labels appear in free-text while structured fields remain partial
profiles.interpretation: The model does not claim language understanding from free text; structured fields preserve some fast path, while unclear records abstain.

profiles.evidence_condition: many agents contend for nearby resource, wallet, quota, or state slots
profiles.interpretation: High contention increases slow-lane load but should not turn resource conflicts into normal passengers.

profiles.evidence_condition: near-miss actions preserve shape but alter amount, destination, identity, or effect
profiles.interpretation: Near-miss semantic drift is intentionally costly: many records leave the fast lane, but piggybacked side effects still fail closed.

noisy_recognition_calibration.claim_boundary: The deterministic oracle may be 1.0000 because the cases are authored. This calibration deliberately reports non-perfect fast-preservation and oracle-handling rates under noisy evidence. The safety target is not perfect recognition; it is zero fast-lane escape for boundary violations and explicit slow/review/unsupported handling when evidence is incomplete.

operations_research_routing.objective: minimize critical-path wait and reviewer backlog subject to action-boundary safety, receipt integrity, fairness, and capacity constraints
operations_research_routing.basis: deterministic scenario model over the action-crowd-control corpus; not observed customer production traffic or a production SLA

routing_decisions.scheduler: attach to primary receipt before or after commit according to evidence profile
routing_decisions.wait_model: does not consume reviewer capacity unless evidence is ambiguous

routing_decisions.scheduler: inherit narrowed pass authority; cannot widen resource, destination, or effect
routing_decisions.wait_model: does not create an independent approval queue
no reviewer queue unless operator appeal is explicitly opened
same resource, wallet, quota, or state slot is resolved before boundary crossing
ambiguous context is delayed until enough evidence exists to classify it
non-blocking enrichment after minimum receipt is persisted

policies.interpretation: Safe-looking but operationally infeasible: every context item, dependency, and real side effect enters the same human or remote review queue.
Better than linear review, but it still makes urgent collisions wait behind lower-urgency ambiguity.
Risk priority protects critical conflicts but can starve low-priority ambiguous evidence.
Classify first, fold context, contain dependent actions, block piggybacks, coalesce related conflicts, then schedule the remaining slow lane by deadline and risk.

operations_research_routing.interpretation: Operations-research routing makes ZeroGate more than a fast checker: it is a finite-capacity boundary scheduler for large agent fleets. The pass decides local eligibility; the OR layer decides how scarce slow-lane capacity is allocated without widening authority.

timing_study.methodology: batch timing of the local commit evaluator after warmup; pass construction, adapter parsing, durable storage, network, verifier calls, UI approval, and tool execution are excluded
timing_study.interpretation: These numbers are a repeatable local evidence point, not the main proof of speed. The main claim is that the common commit path removes remote dependencies and reduces synchronous transaction steps.

disclosure_boundary.latency_model: local evaluator measured; remote baseline is an explicit scenario model, not a production measurement
